attackers_goals: Data exfiltration, attack tool staging or command and control channel through a trusted service.
description: Abnormal communication with a rare combination of TLS and HTTP User Agent to an external address.
investigative_actions: Examine the legitimacy of the application that produced this rare TLS fingerprint with the external server. Examine the parent process of this application. Check for anomalies at the time when the communication occurred. Verify if the outbound communication is being routed through a legitimate HTTP tunneling solution.
